objectives.name: End-to-End Multimodal RUL Regression Pipeline
objectives.evidence: Complete reproducible pipeline with clean data gate, dual checkpoints, and 14-column prediction tables across 6 folds and official test.

objectives.name: Independent Official Test Evaluation Without Leakage
objectives.evidence: 11 official test bearings evaluated strictly once per frozen seed with weights frozen; non-analytic data-gate verification only.

objectives.name: Missing-Temperature Availability Gating and Robustness
objectives.evidence: Architecture handles missing temperature without NaN/Inf via availability gating; operational on all 3 missing-temperature test bearings. However, temperature has not demonstrated superior accuracy over vibration-only modeling.

objectives.name: Outperform Traditional Handcrafted Machine Learning Baseline
objectives.evidence: Multi-seed ensemble slightly improves official endpoint MAE (3264.0s vs 3502.9s) and RMSE (4140.0s vs 4378.0s), but Random Forest achieves superior window MAE (6558.1s vs 8191.5s) and higher IEEE PHM score (0.11422 vs 0.08465).

objectives.name: Outperform Single-Modality Deep Learning Baselines
objectives.evidence: On 6-fold development validation, VibrationOnlyBaseline achieves 1738.0s Endpoint MAE and 1947.8s Endpoint RMSE, outperforming the multimodal CNN-BiLSTM-Attention model (2979.8s Endpoint MAE, 3190.2s Endpoint RMSE).

objectives.name: Demonstrate Cross-Modal and Temporal Attention Contribution
objectives.evidence: MainModel_NoAttention achieves 2552.0s Endpoint MAE on 6-fold development validation compared to 2979.8s for CNNBiLSTMAttentionRUL. Current ablation evidence indicates temporal attention adds optimization difficulty rather than benefit.

objectives.name: Achieve Lifetime RMSE Below 10%
objectives.evidence: Official test endpoint RMSE is 4,140.0s (relative RMSE ~20-23% of operating duration). On 6-fold development validation, the winning candidate (OPT2_06) achieves a normalized trajectory RMSE of 0.288 (28.8% of bearing lifetime). Both metrics exceed the 10% target. Per SPEC Section 20, development endpoint error with zero target cannot be used to claim this objective.

objectives.name: Transformer Architecture Comparison
objectives.evidence: Deferred until development optimization of primary CNN-BiLSTM architecture is complete in accordance with SPEC.md Section 7.4.
